description: List a repo's pull requests (GitHub) or merge requests (GitLab). Optional state filter.

provider.description: The git host to read from, one of the ids orient lists: 'github', 'gitlab', 'bitbucket' or 'ado', e.g. 'gitlab' for merge requests.

repo.description: The repository name without the organisation, e.g. 'parthenon', the flagship repo, which is used when omitted.

state.description: Filter by state, one of 'open', 'closed', 'merged' or 'all', e.g. 'merged'; when omitted the provider's own default applies.

name: list_pull_requests
title: List pull requests / merge requests
